page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture. The server features 72 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It includes 288.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per virtual core.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput interconnectivity for distributed applications. It comes with no included local disk storage, requiring deployment alongside external cloud block storage for persistent data operations. Additionally, the instance lacks dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs, directing primary compute tasks exclusively through the CPU array.

The hardware profile provides high compute core density alongside proportional system RAM, supporting large-scale enterprise applications without specialized resource imbalances. The high network bandwidth allows fast network operations, offsetting the reliance on attached network storage. Ideal workloads include enterprise web applications, distributed container orchestrations, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, medium-scale database nodes, and general backend application servers.
